caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate goblet centered within a rectangular frame on a plain background. The goblet is rendered in grayscale, with shading used to indicate its reflective glass surface. The bowl of the goblet has a decorative pattern; the upper part features symmetrical, fan-shaped engravings radiating outwards, while the midsection displays a diamond pattern composed of small, raised, pyramid-like shapes contained within a triangular border. The stem of the goblet is straight and gently curves before meeting a broad, circular base. The entire goblet is drawn with careful attention to proportion and detail, and there are no other objects or background elements present in the composition.
title: Molded Water Glass
